title: 科技巨头领涨美国市场 标普月线持平
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: And right now we are two minutes away from the end of the trading day.
segments.zh: 现在距离交易日结束还有两分钟。

segments.en: Remain Bostick here with Emily Grafail. We're taking you through to that closing bell. It's a global simulcast.
segments.zh: 我是Remain Bostick，和Emily Grafail一起，带您看到收盘钟声，这是全球同步直播。

segments.en: Carol Maser, she pops up on the screen. Tim Stenevich, he's there too.
segments.zh: Carol Maser出现在屏幕上，Tim Stenevich也在。

segments.en: Welcome to our audiences across all of our Bloomberg platform, Sellevich and Radio, our partnership with YouTube.
segments.zh: 欢迎所有Bloomberg平台的观众，包括Sellevich、广播以及YouTube合作伙伴。

segments.en: Would this be better? I don't know. For all you radio folks, cover your ears because Carol, who knows what Carol's about to do.
segments.zh: 这样会更好吗？我不知道。广播听众请捂住耳朵，因为Carol，谁知道Carol要做什么。

segments.en: I'm going to stay here on Wall Street. We should point out, S&P up, the NASDAQ up, the Dow up, though we're seeing Russell 2000 midcaps transports
segments.zh: 我留在华尔街。标普上涨，纳斯达克上涨，道指上涨，但罗素2000、中盘股和运输股下跌。

segments.en: in the red closing out the week and closing out pretty much what across the board is a down month for at least the major benchmarks here in the US.
segments.zh: 本周收盘，美国主要基准指数普遍下跌，本月整体表现不佳。

segments.en: Yeah, it's kind of interesting to see. I mean, so much movement, I feel like this last month, but nonetheless, I don't know.
segments.zh: 是的，看到这些很有趣。我觉得这个月波动很大，但不管怎样，我不知道。

segments.en: We're wrapping up overall little change for the month.
segments.zh: 我们总结一下，本月整体变化不大。

segments.en: I've been looking at the Mag 7. It's up about three and a half percent in today's session.
segments.zh: 我一直在关注Mag 7，今天上涨了约3.5%。

segments.en: So once again, investors moving into these big tech names, not if you're Apple, Apple's having a really rough day, but everybody else, they are up.
segments.zh: 市场参与者再次涌入大型科技股，苹果表现不佳，但其他科技股均上涨。

segments.en: So that's the thing, a tech stocks have had a rough month. It's been a very volatile month, but we are actually completely flat month to date
segments.zh: 科技股本月波动较大，但截至目前标普500指数基本持平。

segments.en: on the S&P 500 right now despite the ups and downs over the last four weeks.
segments.zh: 尽管过去四周有起伏，但标普500指数本月至今持平。

segments.en: Yeah, the VIX is down as well, at least for today. It's interesting, but this is kind of what we expect for a July, a summer month, not too much movement
segments.zh: 今日VIX指数也下跌，这符合夏季市场预期，指数层面波动不大。

segments.en: on the index level. I love your optimism. You are definitely glass half of full kind of people.
segments.zh: 我喜欢你们的乐观，你们绝对是半杯满的人。
